title: Introduction Step Window Drag Handle
description: On introduction step windows add a drag handle in the middle of the top to be able to drag the UI element.
summary: Fixed the introduction info-box drag boundary at its root by separating automatic placement inset from direct-manipulation bounds. Authored placement retains the 16 px visual gap, while pointer dragging now clamps to the exact viewport edges (0 through viewport minus measured box size). Added a shared pure clamp helper and extended the existing in-file component and helper tests to cover all four borders. Focused Vitest verification passes: 6 tests. Full typecheck, lint, and Storybook runtime checks were attempted but remain blocked by unrelated concurrent repository errors (generated StyleSpec/icon paths and other UI types; missing react-hooks lint rule; Vite/native dependency optimization).
